narration_fil: Sabi ng tagapag-alaga, hindi makainom si Niko, tatlong taong gulang, at isinusuka ang lahat. Mahirap siyang gisingin.
narration_en: A caregiver says three-year-old Niko cannot drink and vomits everything. He is unusually difficult to wake.

display_en:

Any danger sign: urgent facility assessment

narration_fil: Itanong ang pag-inom, pagsusuka at kombulsyon. Tingnan ang antas ng kamalayan at kasalukuyang kombulsyon. Kung may kahit isang danger sign, agad ipasuri sa pasilidad. Sabihin ang eksaktong nakita at ayusin ang ligtas na paglipat.
narration_en: Ask about drinking, vomiting and convulsions. Observe alertness and current convulsions. Any general danger sign needs urgent facility assessment; communicate the exact sign and arrange safe transfer.

What is the first response?
Choose before reading the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Hindi makainom si Niko, isinusuka ang lahat at mahirap gisingin. Ano ang uuna?
check.prompt_en: Niko cannot drink, vomits everything and is hard to wake. What comes first?

options.fil: Agad ipasuri si Niko sa pasilidad.
options.en: Arrange urgent facility assessment for Niko.

options.fil: Bantayan muna sa bahay at i-refer kung may dumagdag na senyales.
options.en: Watch him at home and refer if more signs appear.

options.fil: Painumin muna siya nang paunti-unti bago magpasya.
options.en: Give him small sips of water before deciding.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Tama. Kailangang agad ipasuri sa pasilidad kahit isang danger sign lang, at higit sa isa na ang kay Niko. 2: Naaantala ang lunas kapag hinintay ang lahat ng senyales. Sapat ang isang danger sign para agad mag-refer. 3: Hindi makainom si Niko at isinusuka ang lahat. Huwag painumin ang batang hindi ligtas lumunok.
check.feedback_en: 1: Right. Any one general danger sign needs urgent facility assessment, and Niko already has more than one. 2: Waiting for every sign delays care. One danger sign is enough to refer urgently. 3: Niko cannot drink and vomits everything. Do not give anything by mouth to a child who cannot safely swallow.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
May danger sign si Niko, at sapat ang isa
Walang diagnosis at walang paghihintay
Agad ipasuri at ayusin ang ligtas na paglipat
Handover: hindi makainom, isinusuka lahat, mahirap gisingin
display_en:
Niko has danger signs, and one is enough
No illness label and no waiting
Urgent assessment and safe transfer
Handover: cannot drink, vomits everything, hard to wake
narration_fil: Hindi makainom si Niko, isinusuka ang lahat at mahirap gisingin. Alam ng BHW na sapat ang kahit isang danger sign. Hindi siya naghihintay ng iba pang senyales at hindi nagbibigay ng diagnosis. Agad niyang ipinasusuri si Niko sa pasilidad at inaayos ang ligtas na paglipat. Sa handover, sinasabi niya ang eksaktong nakita: hindi makainom, isinusuka ang lahat, mahirap gisingin.
narration_en: Niko cannot drink, vomits everything and is unusually hard to wake. The BHW knows one danger sign is enough, so she does not wait for more signs or name an illness. She arranges urgent facility assessment and safe transfer. In the handover she states the exact signs: cannot drink, vomits everything, hard to wake.

display_fil:
Huwag magbigay ng diagnosis
Huwag hintayin ang lahat ng senyales
Huwag painumin ang batang hindi ligtas lumunok
display_en:
Do not label the illness
Do not wait for every sign
Nothing by mouth if the child cannot safely swallow
narration_fil: Huwag magbigay ng diagnosis, maghintay ng lahat ng senyales, o magpainom sa batang hindi ligtas lumunok.
narration_en: Do not label the illness, wait for every sign, or give anything by mouth to a child who cannot safely swallow.

Ano ang sasabihin sa handover?

What should the handover say?
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Tinanong ng pasilidad kung ano ang nangyari kay Niko. Ano ang sasabihin sa handover?
check.prompt_en: The facility asks what is wrong with Niko. What should the handover say?

options.en: That it looks like severe dehydration.

options.fil: Hindi siya makainom, isinusuka ang lahat at mahirap gisingin.
options.en: He cannot drink, vomits everything and is hard to wake.

options.fil: Na sumuka lang siya ngayon, dahil baka mawala rin ang ibang senyales.
options.en: Only that he vomited today, since the other signs may pass.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Huwag magbigay ng diagnosis. Ang pasilidad ang magpapasya; ang nakita ang iuulat mo. 2: Tama. Inuulit ng factual na handover ang eksaktong danger signs na iniulat at nakita. 3: Kapag may inalis na senyales, natatago ang pagka-urgent. Sabihin ang eksaktong nakita.
check.feedback_en: 1: Do not label the illness. The facility decides; your handover gives what was observed. 2: Right. A factual handover repeats the exact danger signs reported and observed. 3: Leaving out signs hides how urgent this is. State the exact signs you found.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

narration_fil: Sa Lunes, gamitin ang kaparehong checklist sa bagong kathang-isip na kaso. Itala ang nakita at kung sino ang tatawagan. Tukuyin ang danger sign, magpa-agarang referral, at ulitin ang aktuwal na obserbasyon sa handover.
narration_en: On Monday, use the same checklist with a new fictional case. Record observations and the confirmed contact. Identify at least one danger sign, activate urgent referral and repeat the observation in a factual handover.
